CustomField.inlineHelpText: Vanity should typically be the customer name and will be in the link to the Tanium Cloud instance: [vanity].cloud.tanium.com, for example abccompany.cloud.tanium.com (USG: abccompany.cloud.taniumfed.com). Please enter only the vanity portion in this field. Do not include values with "poc" or "test" in the vanity Alphanumeric text ONLY. No special characters besides hyphen are allowed.
